_readme: Verified US mobile-app presence per tracked chain — a structure/intent (DTC-channel) datum. Curated by hand from Apple App Store (US) candidates surfaced by `python -m chain_atlas apps probe`; the probe never writes here (name collisions require human verification). kind: own = the brand's own app; platform = a third-party ordering platform's app for the brand (e.g. Chowbus, Menusifu); none = checked, no US app. platforms lists only what is confirmed (iOS is programmatically checkable; Android/Google Play is a manual field). PRO-tier: rides the structure layer of the Pro export, never the public map/data. See chain_atlas/apps.py and [[cfc-analytics-paywall]].
